sentences.en: What do we know about the climatic history of Mars?
sentences.zh: 我们对火星的气候历史了解多少？

sentences.en: Environmental pollution triggered climatic changes all over Earth.
sentences.zh: 环境污染引发了地球上各地的气候变化。

sentences.en: Global climatic changes may have been responsible for the extinction of the dinosaurs.
sentences.zh: 全球气候变化可能是导致恐龙灭绝的原因之一。

senses.zh: 气候的,风土的,受气候影响的
